caption: The drawing shows a wooden door with a total of eight rectangular panels arranged in two columns and four rows. The main body of the door is reddish-brown in color, resembling stained wood. Each of the eight panels has a green border, and inside each panel is a brown and beige decorative pattern that resembles a stylized wood grain or feather. The door has a black rectangular handle with a round knob positioned on the left side, about one-third of the way down from the top. The door is surrounded by a beige frame, and part of the cream-colored wall is visible around it. On the lower left and right sides, small sections of the wall feature horizontal reddish-brown panels with rectangular beige and green accents that match the main pattern of the door. In the bottom right corner, the name "FRITZ BOEHMER" is written in small, neat print.
title: Zoar Door
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
